name: Monitoring framework

subjectOf.text: The existing framework for monitoring AI agents on cryptocurrency payment rails identifies the key actors but fails to deliver viable solutions, because it does not specify scalability and adaptability challenges and omits critical risks.
subjectOf.abstract: while identifying key actors, falls short of delivering viable solutions. In particular, it fails to identify specifically scalability and adaptability challenges, and omits critical risks.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: current monitoring ecosystem across exchanges, infrastructure providers, compliance services, developers and owners

subjectOf.text: The current monitoring framework is reactive rather than proactive, because it offers no prescriptive measures such as predictive analytics or cross actor protocols that would anticipate evolving risks.
subjectOf.abstract: offers no prescriptive measures—such as predictive analytics or cross-actor protocols—to anticipate evolving risks, rendering it reactive rather than proactive.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: existing monitoring of AI agents on cryptocurrency rails

subjectOf.text: The proposed solutions for future AI monitoring fail to propose feedback driven mechanisms that balance innovation with oversight, which leaves regulatory gaps and scalability bottlenecks unresolved.
